name: 5,6-dibromo-N-methyltryptamine
summary: 5,6-Dibromo-N-methyltryptamine, also known as 5,6-dibromo-NMT, is a substituted tryptamine alkaloid that occurs naturally in marine sponges.

uses.en: It is studied as a natural product from marine sponges. It has no medical or recreational use.
uses.zh: 它作為海綿動物的天然產物被研究，沒有醫療或娛樂用途。
uses.zhHans: 它作为海绵动物的天然产物被研究，没有医疗或娱乐用途。

fact.en: It is made by marine sponges. Sponges are among the richest sources of brominated compounds in nature, because they can take bromide straight from seawater.
fact.zh: 它由海綿動物製造。海綿是自然界中含溴化合物最豐富的來源之一，因為牠們能直接從海水中取得溴離子。
fact.zhHans: 它由海绵动物制造。海绵是自然界中含溴化合物最丰富的来源之一，因为牠们能直接从海水中取得溴离子。
